verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for an IT, identity and device-management product, since on-prem deployment options exist in this category. Nothing in the pack shows Rippling IT can be self-hosted. The evidence describes a hosted platform reached through a cloud REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com, a client npm SDK and an MCP server, none of which amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
